releases.displayName: Share Your Feedback on the Upcoming LAPIN Update!

items.text: Hello, Big Bunnies!
Our development team is preparing a major update for LAPIN, focusing on making Easy Mode easier and improving quality-of-life features.
We'd love to hear your thoughts on the upcoming update!
Easy Mode difficulty – Were there any parts you found particularly difficult? Are there any areas where you'd like to see the difficulty adjusted?
Other improvements – Are there any quality-of-life features or other improvements you'd like to see?
Hello, big bunnies!
We’re here to share the details of LAPIN’s v.1.10.0.0 update.
The opening logo screen can now be skipped quickly by pressing a key.
The screen and audio now gradually fade out when exiting the game.
In addition to the key configured in the settings, Enter and Space can now also be used as confirmation keys by default.
When using a keyboard, Enter and Space can be used in addition to Z, the default confirmation key.
Animations have been added to the rabbits on the title screen.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294784/f2c4a9da33aa0c194a606031b3f419a0bd4653e4.gif"]
Animations have been added to the rabbits in the ending illustration.
If you encounter any bugs, please feel free to report them at any time through Discord, \[contact@studiodoodal.com](mailto:contact@studiodoodal.com), or the Steam Discussions forum. Thank you!

Hello Big Rabbits!
We are here to inform you about the February update.
First of all, "Easy Mode" has been updated for players who are new or unfamiliar with platformers!
By choosing "Easy Mode", you can explore the world and the story more comfortably.
There are two difficulties: "Normal Mode" and "Easy Mode".
You can choose one of the two when starting the game or selecting an empty save slot for the first time.
※ The default difficulty for Early Access is "Normal Mode".
You can also go to ESC -> Settings to change the difficulty.
※ Even for a save slot that was created before the update, the difficulty mode can be changed in-game.

Chapter 3 has been improved with the addition/editing of scenarios.: (Particularly in Chapters 1 and 2, detailed scenario improvements have been made to more clearly indicate that Jose knows the human language.)
Some background resources in Chapter 1 have been modified/added.
Various character animations have been added, including Talki preening its wings and Jose reading a book.: The name of a specific flower has been changed.: ("Mulle" was changed to "Everwish".)
Interactive elements have been added to the prologue and Chapter 3.: (Added a dropped book at the entrance to Jose's room in the prologue and added a book to the ancient burrow library in Chapter 3.)

After experiencing an episode, a pop-up appears with a photocard covering the screen.: Studio Doodal will continue to work hard to improve user experience.: We welcome any reports of relevant bugs and issues through the comments section of the related notice, the Steam discussion page, or our email address (studiodoodal@gmail.com).

Hello Big Rabbits,
There was an important update for December!
The 'Piece Map' function for seed collection has been updated!
Open the 'Piece Map' on the Liebe Note.
You can return to the area where you played in the past to acquire the seeds you missed and some collectables.
Refer to the Piece Map UI and Seed page to get all the seeds you missed!
※ In addition to seeds, you can acquire missing collectable elements that appear on the platform.
※ Collectables obtained by chatting with friends in special circumstances cannot be obtained.
The seeds you have just acquired are marked in pink, the seeds you have already acquired are marked in white, and the seeds you have not acquired are marked in brown.
You can only enter the 'Piece Map' that you have completed.
If you want to return to the present in the 'Piece Map', please open Liebe Note and click the 'Piece Map' that is currently in progress.

If the progress is reversed, it will automatically return to the present.: If there are bugs on the ‘Piece Map’ system, please tell us.: Steam discussions, SNS, e-mail(studiodoodal@gmail.com) etc.: .: .: .
